text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx spike in region euc2 (NLB + ingress). Incident INC-2026-5011. 5xx rate 9% over 3m; connection resets and target deregistrations observed. Dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/alerts/INC-2026-5011

pagerduty: Paging oncall-lee (P1). Please acknowledge.

oncall-lee: ACK. Jumping in. Any idea if this is NLB-only or across ALB/Envoy?

sre_maya: I'm looking. TLDR: NLB target groups in euc2a are showing health check flaps and backend pods report `connection reset by peer`. Envoy logs show `upstream connect error or disconnect` across a subset of nodes. Pattern started ~13:12 UTC.

infra-omar: Correlating with cloud events12 I see a brief control-plane network event in euc2a-az3 ~13:100 UTC and several ENI reattachments. Also kubelet reported `NetworkPlugin lost` on two nodes. No recent SG/NACL changes. Cloud provider shows a degraded link on a rack, ticket opened with provider: CP-67321.

eng-zoe: We pushed a minor ingress controller bump earlier (d4f2b) that tweaks worker pool sizing. Not sure it's related, but can roll back quickly. Commit: https://git.internal/redwood/ingress/commit/d4f2b

oncall-lee: Triage plan: (1) reduce weight to euc2b/euc1 to relieve euc2a, (2) mark impacted NLB targets out of service to stop griefing, (3) consider rollback of ingress change if traffic shift doesn't stabilize. I'll run weighted DNS change to shift 65% to euc2b.

oncall-lee: Executing weighted shift: ```aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z98765 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"euc2b","Weight":65,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"198.51.100.11"}]}}]}'```

sre_maya: Doing immediate target suppression on NLB tg-ingress-euc2a: ```aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:tg-ingress-euc2a --targets Id=i-0fed...``` This will drain failing instances; doing in small batch to avoid overload.

infra-omar: K8s nodes with NetworkPlugin errors are being cordoned and drained: `kubectl cordon node/euc2a-az3-02 && kubectl drain node/euc2a-az3-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Spawning replacement nodes as well.

eng-zoe: I'm proceeding with rollback of the ingress controller on the euc2a canaries: ```kubectl -n ingress rollout undo deployment/ingress-controller --to-revision=12``` Monitoring.

sre_maya: After suppression + dns shift, 5xx dropped from 9% -> 1.8% over 2m. Upstream resets decreased. NLB target re-registration shows healthy counts rising.

cs-luke: Any idea which customers saw errors? Need a short list for CS incident emails.

sre_maya: Quick log tally (10m window): cust-lumen ~310 errors, cust-pioneer ~48, misc keys ~23. Most were transient 502/504 at ingress.

cs-luke: Thanks. I'll start drafting customer notes: "Transient errors in euc2 between 13:10-13:20 UTC, most traffic routed successfully after 13:15 following mitigation." Will open cases for cust-lumen and cust-pioneer.

oncall-lee: Handing over to sre_maya as incident lead for follow-up. I'll stay available for 15m.

sre_maya: Taking incident owner. Follow-ups: (1) infra-omar to confirm root cause with provider CP-67321 and node replacement outcome, (2) eng-zoe to validate ingress controller worker-pool changes and add pre-deploy canary, (3) SRE to add NLB synthetic health probes and auto-shift policy if latency/5xx thresholds hit.

infra-omar: Provider acknowledges degraded rack link; hardware team replacing top-of-rack switch. Node replacements completed; ENI events ceased. Provider ETA 2 hours for full validation. Logged internal ticket INFRA-3910.

eng-zoe: Will add a pre-deploy canary to run on 5% of traffic in the same AZ before promotion, and revert the worker-pool change in next patch. Opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ingress/pull/872

sre_maya: Post-incident notes: mitigation actions were DNS weight shift + NLB target deregistration + node drains + ingress rollback on canaries. Impact window ~13:10-13:18 UTC. Owner for postmortem: sre_maya. Will schedule RCA and add follow-ups to the incident doc.

cs-luke: Customer comms sent to impacted accounts; will attach copy to the incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-5011 status: MITIGATED (mitigations: route53 weight shift, target deregistration, node drains, ingress canary rollback). Incident owner: sre_maya. Follow-up tasks: INC-2026-5011-FU (sre_maya), INFRA-3910 (infra-omar), INGRESS-872 (eng-zoe).

sre_maya: Closing alert channel; will convert to incident ticket and invite infra/eng for RCA meeting. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
